instruction: Enable the 'Do Not Track' setting in Chrome's privacy settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to chrome://settings/manageProfile, cleared the existing profile name 'Person 1', and typed 'Thomas' to rename the Chrome profile.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome settings pages, interact with text input fields, modify Chrome configuration values
metadata.task_rationale: Related Chrome settings task - enabling Do Not Track requires navigating to Privacy settings and toggling a switch, similar interaction pattern to editing profile name
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Chrome's 'Do Not Track' feature in privacy settings. Evaluator uses official enable_do_not_track getter to check the setting state and exact_match metric to verify it equals string 'true'. [Fixed: changed expected value from boolean true to string 'true' to match getter return type]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed expected.rules.expected from boolean true to string 'true' to match get_enable_do_not_track getter return type, which returns 'true'/'false' strings
metadata.verification: get_enable_do_not_track returns string 'true' or 'false'; exact_match compares result == expected; 'true' == 'true' will correctly evaluate to True

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_enable_do_not_track correctly reads Chrome's Preferences JSON file and returns string 'true' when enable_do_not_track is set. Expected value is string 'true', matching the getter's return type. exact_match compares 'true' == 'true' which correctly evaluates to 1.0.
Postconfig correctly kills and restarts Chrome to flush preferences to disk before the getter reads the Preferences file, ensuring fresh state.
The instruction has a single requirement (enable Do Not Track) and the evaluator fully covers it. No missing verification steps.
